items.passage: Today is Monday at school. Our classroom is big and clean. Ms. Lin is our teacher. She asks every student to take out a book, a pencil, and a notebook. We read a short story and write three sentences. After class, I put my heavy bag beside my desk. I like to learn with my friends.
items.s4_0: I read a book at school.
items.s4_1: The teacher writes on the desk.
items.s4_2: My new pencil is in my bag.
items.s4_3: We study in a clean classroom.
